crossRefs.note: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.
He said to them, “To you is given the mystery of God’s Kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in…
Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.
No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for…
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be…
behold, I have done according to your word. Behold, I have given you a wise and understanding heart; so that there has…
God gave Solomon abundant wisdom and understanding, and very great understanding, even as the sand that is on the…
in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.
For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul…

parallels.note: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from the king which he didn’t tell her.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from Solomon which he didn’t tell her.
translations.bsb: And Solomon answered all her questions; nothing was too difficult for him to explain.
translations.kjv: And Solomon told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not.
translations.asv: And Solomon told her all her questions; and there was not anything hid from Solomon which he told her not.
